calls.statement:
SELECT 
  fiscal_year, 
  fiscal_period, 
  fiscal_period_label,
  period_start_date, 
  period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND fiscal_period >= 7
  AND fiscal_period <= 12
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product_old
WHERE category LIKE '%Garden%' OR category = 'Garden'

SELECT sku
FROM dim_product_old
WHERE category = 'Garden'
ORDER BY sku

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period >= 7
  AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT dpo.sku) as garden_skus_in_old,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dp.sku IS NOT NULL THEN dp.sku END) as garden_skus_in_current
FROM dim_product_old dpo
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'

SELECT 
  dpo.sku,
  dpo.category as old_category,
  dp.category as current_category,
  COUNT(*) as sample_count
FROM dim_product_old dpo
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dpo.sku = dp.sku AND dp.is_current = TRUE
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND dpo.category != dp.category
GROUP BY dpo.sku, dpo.category, dp.category
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  dpo.category as old_category,
  dp.category as current_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dpo.sku) as sku_count
FROM dim_product_old dpo
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON dpo.sku = dp.sku AND dp.is_current = TRUE
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY dpo.category, dp.category
ORDER BY sku_count DESC

SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_amounts,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_amounts,
  COUNT(*) as total_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period >= 7
  AND d.fiscal_period <= 12

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as staff_purchases,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period >= 7
  AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  'FY2024/25' as fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period >= 7
  AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
